mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in a month and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises > 1% MoM and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 7% and simultaneously nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decrease, it signals a significant labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE > 7% and PAYEMS decreases, but 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) coupled with a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST decreases and UNRATE rises, but 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% YoY and industrial production (INDPRO) is stagnant or declining, it signals a supply-side recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 YoY < 1% and INDPRO is stagnant/declining, but 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
